druid.name: Faerie Fire (Feral)
tooltip: Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

druid.name: Feral Charge
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Causes you to charge an enemy, immobilizing and interrupting any spell being cast for 4 sec.

druid.name: Insect Swarm
description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 2% and causing 324 Nature damage over 12 sec.

druid.name: Moonkin Form
description: Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form the armor contribution from items is increased by 360% and all party members within 30 yards have their spell critical chance increased by 3%. The Moonkin can only cast Balance spells while shapeshifted.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

druid.name: Nature's Grasp
description: While active, any time an enemy strikes the caster they have a 35% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots (Rank 6). Only useable outdoors. 1 charge. Lasts 45 sec.
(Proc chance: 35%)

druid.name: Nature's Swiftness
description: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.
Modifies Cast Time -100%:

Entangling Roots, Entangling Roots, Entangling Roots, Entangling Roots, Entangling Roots, Entangling Roots, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Healing Touch, Hibernate, Hibernate, Hibernate, Nourish, Rebirth, Rebirth, Rebirth, Rebirth, Rebirth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Regrowth, Soothe Animal, Soothe Animal, Soothe Animal, Starsurge, Wrath, Wrath, Wrath, Wrath, Wrath, Wrath, Wrath, Wrath

druid.name: Swiftmend
description: Consumes a Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect on a friendly target to instantly heal them an amount equal to 12 sec. of Rejuvenation or 18 sec. of Regrowth.

druid.name: Healing Touch
description: Heals a friendly target for 2267 to 2677.

druid.name: Mark of the Wild
description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 285, all attributes by 12 and all resistances by 20 for 30 min.

druid.name: Wrath
description: Causes 248 to 277 Nature damage to the target.

druid.name: Moonfire
description: Burns the enemy for 195 to 228 Arcane damage and then an additional 384 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

druid.name: Rejuvenation
description: Heals the target for 888 over 12 sec.

druid.name: Thorns
description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

druid.name: Entangling Roots
description: Roots the target in place and causes 270 Nature damage over 27 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only useable outdoors.

druid.name: Bear Form
description: Shapeshift into a bear, increasing melee attack power by 120, armor contribution from items by 180%, and health by 560. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

druid.name: Demoralizing Roar
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 138. Lasts 30 sec.

druid.name: Growl
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

druid.name: Maul
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.

druid.name: Teleport: Moonglade
description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

druid.name: Enrage
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Generates 20 rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

druid.name: Regrowth
description: Heals a friendly target for 1003 to 1119 and another 1064 over 21 sec.

druid.name: Bash
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

druid.name: Cure Poison
description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

druid.name: Aquatic Form
description: Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

druid.name: Swipe
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 83 damage.

druid.name: Faerie Fire
description: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

druid.name: Hibernate
description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

druid.name: Cat Form
description: Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 40 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

druid.name: Claw
description: Claw the enemy, causing 115 additional damage. Awards 1 combo point.
(Proc chance: 40%)

druid.name: Prowl
description: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

druid.name: Rebirth
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 2200 health and 2800 mana.

druid.name: Rip
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:
1 point : 270 damage over 12 sec.
2 points: 438 damage over 12 sec.
3 points: 606 damage over 12 sec.
4 points: 774 damage over 12 sec.
5 points: 942 damage over 12 sec.

druid.name: Starfire
description: Causes 496 to 584 Arcane damage to the target.

druid.name: Shred
description: Shred the target, causing 225% damage plus 180 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

druid.name: Soothe Animal
description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

druid.name: Rake
description: Rake the target for 58 damage and an additional 96 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

druid.name: Remove Curse
description: Dispels 1 Curse from a friendly target.

druid.name: Tiger's Fury
description: Increases damage done by 40 for 6 sec.

druid.name: Abolish Poison
description: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

druid.name: Dash
description: Increases movement speed by 60% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

druid.name: Challenging Roar
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

druid.name: Cower
description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

druid.name: Tranquility
description: Regenerates all nearby group members for 294 every 2 seconds for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

druid.name: Travel Form
description: Transforms the druid into a travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

druid.name: Ferocious Bite
description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 2.70000005 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
1 point : 199-259 damage
2 points: 346-406 damage
3 points: 493-553 damage
4 points: 640-700 damage
5 points: 787-847 damage

druid.name: Ravage
description: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 343 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

druid.name: Track Humanoids
description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

druid.name: Frenzied Regeneration
tooltip: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
description: Converts up to 10 rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of rage is converted into 20 health.

druid.name: Pounce
description: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 150 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

druid.name: Dire Bear Form
description: Shapeshift into a dire bear, increasing melee attack power by 180, armor contribution from items by 360%, and health by 1240. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

druid.name: Hurricane
description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 134 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

druid.name: Innervate
description: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

druid.name: Barkskin
description: The druid's skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays but non-instant spells take 1 sec longer to cast and melee combat is slowed by 25%. Lasts 15 sec.

druid.name: Gift of the Wild
description: Gives the Gift of the Wild to the target's party, increasing armor by 285, all attributes by 12 and all resistances by 20 for 1 hour.

hunter.name: Aimed Shot
description: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 600.

hunter.name: Bestial Wrath
description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

hunter.name: Counterattack
description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 110 damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

hunter.name: Deterrence
description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

hunter.name: Intimidation
description: Command your pet to intimidate the target on the next successful melee attack, causing a high amount of threat and stunning the target for 3 sec.

hunter.name: Scatter Shot
description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

hunter.name: Trueshot Aura
description: Increases the attack power of party members within 45 yards by 100 . Lasts 30 min.

hunter.name: Wyvern Sting
description: A stinging shot that puts the target to sleep for 12 sec. Any damage will cancel the effect. When the target wakes up, the Sting causes 600 Nature damage over 12 sec. Only usable out of combat. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on the target at a time.

hunter.name: Auto Shot
description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

hunter.name: Raptor Strike
description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 140.

hunter.name: Track Beasts
description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Monkey
description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Serpent Sting
description: Stings the target, causing 555 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

hunter.name: Arcane Shot
description: An instant shot that causes 183 Arcane damage.

hunter.name: Hunter's Mark
description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 110. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.

hunter.name: Concussive Shot
description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Hawk
description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Call Pet
description: Summons your pet to you.

hunter.name: Dismiss Pet
description: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

hunter.name: Feed Pet
description: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

hunter.name: Revive Pet
description: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

hunter.name: Tame Beast
description: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

hunter.name: Track Humanoids
description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Distracting Shot
description: Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 5).

hunter.name: Mend Pet
description: Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

hunter.name: Wing Clip
description: Inflicts 50 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 60% for 10 sec.

hunter.name: Eagle Eye
description: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.

hunter.name: Eyes of the Beast
description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 1 min.

hunter.name: Scare Beast
description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

hunter.name: Immolation Trap
description: Place a fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Mongoose Bite
description: Counterattack the enemy for 115 damage. Can only be performed after you dodge.

hunter.name: Multi-Shot
description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for an additional 150 damage.

hunter.name: Track Undead
description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Disengage
description: Attempts to disengage from the target, reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Character exits combat mode.

hunter.name: Freezing Trap
description: Place a frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Scorpid Sting
description: Stings the target, reducing Strength and Agility by 68 for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

hunter.name: Beast Lore
description: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.

hunter.name: Track Hidden
description: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Rapid Fire
description: Increases ranged attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

hunter.name: Track Elementals
description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Frost Trap
description: Place a frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Beast
description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Feign Death
description: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts up to 6 min.

hunter.name: Flare
description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

hunter.name: Track Demons
description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Explosive Trap
description: Place a fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 265 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Viper Sting
description: Stings the target, draining 1108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Pack
description: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Track Giants
description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Volley
description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 80 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every second for 6 sec.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Wild
description: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Track Dragonkin
description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

hunter.name: Tranquilizing Shot
description: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

mage.name: Shoot
description: Attack with an equipped wand.

mage.name: Arcane Power
description: When activated, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast. This effect lasts 15 sec.

mage.name: Blast Wave
description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 462 to 544 Fire damage, and dazing them for 6 sec.

mage.name: Cold Snap
description: When activated, this spell finishes the cooldown on all of your Frost spells.

mage.name: Combustion
description: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 critical strikes with Fire spells.

mage.name: Ice Barrier
description: Instantly shields you, absorbing 826 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, spells will not be interrupted.

mage.name: Ice Block
description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells.

mage.name: Presence of Mind
description: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

mage.name: Pyroblast
description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 716 to 890 Fire damage and an additional 268 Fire damage over 12 sec.

mage.name: Arcane Intellect
description: Increases the target's Intellect by 31 for 30 min.

mage.name: Fireball
description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 596 to 760 Fire damage and an additional 76 Fire damage over 8 sec.

mage.name: Frost Armor
description: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

mage.name: Conjure Water
description: Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

mage.name: Frostbolt
description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 515 to 555 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

mage.name: Conjure Food
description: Conjures 10 cinnamon rolls, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

mage.name: Fire Blast
description: Blasts the enemy for 446 to 524 Fire damage.

mage.name: Arcane Missiles
description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 230 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.

mage.name: Polymorph
description: Transforms the enemy into a pig, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the pig cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

mage.name: Frost Nova
description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 71 to 79 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

mage.name: Dampen Magic
description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 90 and healing spells by up to 180. Lasts 10 min.

mage.name: Slow Fall
description: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.

mage.name: Arcane Explosion
description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 249 to 270 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

mage.name: Detect Magic
description: Detects beneficial magic effects on the target for 2 min.

mage.name: Flamestrike
description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 381 to 466 Fire damage and an additional 340 Fire damage over 8 sec.

mage.name: Amplify Magic
description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 75 and healing spells by up to 150. Lasts 10 min.

mage.name: Remove Lesser Curse
description: Removes 1 Curse from a friendly target.

mage.name: Blink
description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from stuns and bonds.

mage.name: Blizzard
description: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 1192 Frost damage over 8 sec.

mage.name: Evocation
description: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%. Lasts 8 sec.

mage.name: Fire Ward
description: Absorbs 920 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.

mage.name: Mana Shield
description: Absorbs 570 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

mage.name: Teleport: Ironforge
description: Teleports the caster to Ironforge.

mage.name: Teleport: Orgrimmar
description: Teleports the caster to Orgrimmar.

mage.name: Teleport: Stormwind
description: Teleports the caster to Stormwind.

mage.name: Teleport: Undercity
description: Teleports the caster to Undercity.

mage.name: Frost Ward
description: Absorbs 920 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.

mage.name: Scorch
description: Scorch the enemy for 237 to 280 Fire damage.

mage.name: Counterspell
description: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

mage.name: Cone of Cold
description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 335 to 365 Frost damage and are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

mage.name: Conjure Mana Agate
description: Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 375 to 425 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

mage.name: Ice Armor
description: Increases Armor by 560 and frost resistance by 15. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

mage.name: Teleport: Darnassus
description: Teleports the caster to Darnassus.

mage.name: Teleport: Thunder Bluff
description: Teleports the caster to Thunder Bluff.

mage.name: Mage Armor
description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 15 and allows 30% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

mage.name: Conjure Mana Jade
description: Conjures a mana jade that can be used to instantly restore 550 to 650 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

mage.name: Portal: Ironforge
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Ironforge.

mage.name: Portal: Orgrimmar
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Orgrimmar.

mage.name: Portal: Stormwind
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Stormwind.

mage.name: Portal: Undercity
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Undercity.

mage.name: Conjure Mana Citrine
description: Conjures a mana citrine that can be used to instantly restore 775 to 925 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

mage.name: Portal: Darnassus
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Darnassus.

mage.name: Portal: Thunder Bluff
description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Thunder Bluff.

mage.name: Arcane Brilliance
description: Infuses the target's party with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

mage.name: Conjure Mana Ruby
description: Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1000 to 1200 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

mage.name: Polymorph: Cow
description: Transforms the enemy into a cow, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the cow cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

paladin.name: Blessing of Kings
description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage dealt from all sources by up to 24 for 5 min. In addition, when the target blocks a melee attack the attacker will take 35 Holy damage. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Divine Favor
description: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

paladin.name: Holy Shield
description: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 130 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

paladin.name: Holy Shock
description: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 365 to 395 Holy damage to an enemy, or 365 to 395 healing to an ally.

paladin.name: Repentance
description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

paladin.name: Seal of Command
description: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.
Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 169 to 186 Holy damage, 339 to 373 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
(1s cooldown)

paladin.name: Devotion Aura
description: Gives 735 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Holy Light
description: Heals a friendly target for 1590 to 1770.

paladin.name: Seal of Righteousness
description: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 22 to 75 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.
Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 170 to 187 Holy damage to an enemy.

paladin.name: Blessing of Might
description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 185 for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Judgement
description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

paladin.name: Divine Protection
description: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.

paladin.name: Seal of the Crusader
description: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 326 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 140. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

paladin.name: Hammer of Justice
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.

paladin.name: Purify
description: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

paladin.name: Blessing of Protection
description: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.

paladin.name: Lay on Hands
description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining mana when used.

paladin.name: Redemption
description: Brings a dead player back to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

paladin.name: Blessing of Wisdom
description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 33 mana every 5 seconds for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Retribution Aura
description: Causes 20 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Righteous Fury
description: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 60%. Lasts 30 min.

paladin.name: Blessing of Freedom
description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Exorcism
description: Causes 505 to 563 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

paladin.name: Flash of Light
description: Heals a friendly target for 348 to 389.

paladin.name: Sense Undead
description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

paladin.name: Concentration Aura
description: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Seal of Justice
description: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

paladin.name: Turn Undead
description: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

paladin.name: Blessing of Salvation
description: Places a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
description: Gives 60 additional Shadow resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Divine Intervention
description: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.

paladin.name: Seal of Light
description: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 94. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 61. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

paladin.name: Frost Resistance Aura
description: Gives 60 additional Frost resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Divine Shield
description: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but increases the time between your attacks by 100%. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.

paladin.name: Fire Resistance Aura
description: Gives 60 additional Fire resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Seal of Wisdom
description: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 90 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 59 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

paladin.name: Blessing of Light
description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Summon Warhorse
description: Summons a warhorse, which serves as a mount. Speed is increased by 60%.

paladin.name: Cleanse
description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

paladin.name: Hammer of Wrath
description: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 504 to 556 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

paladin.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
description: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 55 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Holy Wrath
description: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 490 to 576 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds.

paladin.name: Greater Blessing of Might
description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 185 for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 33 mana every 5 seconds for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Greater Blessing of Light
description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Light, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Greater Blessing of Salvation
description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Salvation, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 15 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Greater Blessing of Sanctuary
description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Sanctuary, reducing damage dealt from all sources by up to 24 for 15 min. In addition, when the target blocks a melee attack the attacker will take 35 Holy damage. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

paladin.name: Summon Charger
description: Summons a Charger, which serves as a mount. Speed is increased by 100%.

priest.name: Shoot
description: Attack with an equipped wand.

priest.name: Holy Nova
description: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 181 to 209 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 302 to 350. These effects cause no threat.

priest.name: Inner Focus
description: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

priest.name: Lightwell
description: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 1600 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

priest.name: Mind Flay
description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 426 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

priest.name: Power Infusion
description: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing by 20%. Lasts 15 sec.

priest.name: Shadowform
description: Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15% and reducing Physical damage done to you by 15%. However, you may not cast Holy spells while in this form.

priest.name: Silence
description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec.

priest.name: Vampiric Embrace
description: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 1 min.

priest.name: Lesser Heal
description: Heal your target for 143 to 165.

priest.name: Power Word: Fortitude
description: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 54 for 30 min.

priest.name: Smite
description: Smite an enemy for 384 to 429 Holy damage.

priest.name: Shadow Word: Pain
description: A word of darkness that causes 852 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

priest.name: Power Word: Shield
description: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 942 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

priest.name: Fade
description: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 5).

priest.name: Renew
description: Heals the target of 970 damage over 15 sec.

priest.name: Desperate Prayer
description: Instantly heals the caster for 1340 to 1579.

priest.name: Hex of Weakness
description: Weakens the target enemy, reducing damage caused by 20 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min.

priest.name: Mind Blast
description: Blasts the target for 508 to 537 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

priest.name: Resurrection
description: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

priest.name: Starshards
description: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 936 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

priest.name: Touch of Weakness
description: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 64 Shadow damage and reduce the damage caused by the attacker by 20 for 2 min.

priest.name: Inner Fire
description: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

priest.name: Cure Disease
description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

priest.name: Psychic Scream
description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

priest.name: Heal
description: Heal your target for 734 to 827.

priest.name: Dispel Magic
description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

priest.name: Devouring Plague
description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 904 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

priest.name: Elune's Grace
description: Reduces ranged damage taken by 95 and increases chance to dodge by 10% for 15 sec.

priest.name: Fear Ward
description: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 10 min.

priest.name: Feedback
description: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

priest.name: Flash Heal
description: Heals a friendly target for 828 to 975.

priest.name: Holy Fire
description: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 355 to 449 Holy damage and an additional 145 Holy damage over 10 sec.

priest.name: Mind Soothe
description: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

priest.name: Shackle Undead
description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

priest.name: Shadowguard
description: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 116 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.
(3.5s cooldown)

priest.name: Mind Vision
description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

priest.name: Mana Burn
description: Drains 746 to 789 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

priest.name: Mind Control
description: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 64, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.

priest.name: Prayer of Healing
description: A powerful prayer heals party members within 30 yards for 1041 to 1099.

priest.name: Shadow Protection
description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.

priest.name: Abolish Disease
description: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.

priest.name: Levitate
description: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Any damage will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.

priest.name: Greater Heal
description: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1966 to 2194.

priest.name: Prayer of Fortitude
description: Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Stamina by 54 for 1 hour.

priest.name: Prayer of Shadow Protection
description: Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.

priest.name: Prayer of Spirit
description: Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

rogue.name: Throw
description: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

rogue.name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

rogue.name: Blade Flurry
description: Increases your attack speed by 20%. In addition, attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

rogue.name: Cold Blood
description: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, or Eviscerate by 100%.

rogue.name: Ghostly Strike
description: A strike that deals 125% weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Hemorrhage
description: An instant strike that damages the opponent and causes the target to hemorrhage, increasing any Physical damage dealt to the target by up to 7. Lasts 30 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Premeditation
description: When used, adds 2 combo points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 10 sec or the combo points are lost.

rogue.name: Preparation
description: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

rogue.name: Riposte
description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

rogue.name: Eviscerate
description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power:
1 point : 224-332 damage
2 points: 394-502 damage
3 points: 564-672 damage
4 points: 734-842 damage
5 points: 904-1012 damage

rogue.name: Pick Lock
description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

rogue.name: Sinister Strike
description: An instant strike that causes 68 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Stealth
description: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

rogue.name: Backstab
description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 225 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Pick Pocket
description: Pick the target's pocket.

rogue.name: Gouge
description: Causes 75 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack. Target must be facing you. Any damage caused will revive the target. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Evasion
description: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

rogue.name: Sap
description: Incapacitates the target for up to 45 sec. Must be stealthed. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage caused will revive the target. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

rogue.name: Slice and Dice
description: Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 30%. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 9 seconds
2 points: 12 seconds
3 points: 15 seconds
4 points: 18 seconds
5 points: 21 seconds

rogue.name: Sprint
description: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

rogue.name: Kick
description: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 80 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

rogue.name: Expose Armor
description: Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing armor per combo point:
1 point : 340 armor
2 points: 680 armor
3 points: 1020 armor
4 points: 1360 armor
5 points: 1700 armor

rogue.name: Garrote
description: Garrote the enemy, causing 552 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Feint
description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

rogue.name: Ambush
description: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 290 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

rogue.name: Rupture
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 272 damage over 8 secs
2 points: 380 damage over 10 secs
3 points: 504 damage over 12 secs
4 points: 644 damage over 14 secs
5 points: 800 damage over 16 secs

rogue.name: Distract
description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

rogue.name: Vanish
description: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).

rogue.name: Cheap Shot
description: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

rogue.name: Disarm Trap
description: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

rogue.name: Kidney Shot
description: Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 2 seconds
2 points: 3 seconds
3 points: 4 seconds
4 points: 5 seconds
5 points: 6 seconds

rogue.name: Blind
description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

shaman.name: Elemental Mastery
description: When activated, this spell gives your next Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell a 100% critical strike chance and reduces the mana cost by 100%.

shaman.name: Mana Tide Totem
description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 20 yards.

shaman.name: Nature's Swiftness
description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

shaman.name: Stormstrike
description: Gives you an extra attack. In addition, the next 2 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

shaman.name: Healing Wave
description: Heals a friendly target for 1620 to 1850.

shaman.name: Lightning Bolt
description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 428 to 477 Nature damage.

shaman.name: Rockbiter Weapon
description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 653 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 5 minutes.

shaman.name: Earth Shock
description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 517 to 545 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

shaman.name: Stoneskin Totem
description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 20 yards, reducing melee damage taken by 30. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Earthbind Totem
description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

shaman.name: Lightning Shield
description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 198 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.
(3.5s cooldown)

shaman.name: Stoneclaw Totem
description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 480 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.

shaman.name: Flame Shock
description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 292 Fire damage immediately and 320 Fire damage over 12 sec.

shaman.name: Flametongue Weapon
description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 37 to 112 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts for 5 minutes.

shaman.name: Searing Totem
description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.

shaman.name: Strength of Earth Totem
description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party members within 20 yards by 77. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Ancestral Spirit
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

shaman.name: Fire Nova Totem
description: Summons a Fire Nova Totem that has 5 health and lasts 5 sec. Unless it is destroyed within 4 sec., the totem inflicts 413 to 459 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd.

shaman.name: Purge
description: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.

shaman.name: Cure Poison
description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

shaman.name: Tremor Totem
description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Frost Shock
description: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 492 to 520 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

shaman.name: Frostbrand Weapon
description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 187 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 5 minutes.

shaman.name: Ghost Wolf
description: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

shaman.name: Healing Stream Totem
description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 1 min that heals group members within 20 yards for 14 every 2 seconds.

shaman.name: Lesser Healing Wave
description: Heals a friendly target for 832 to 928.

shaman.name: Cure Disease
description: Cures 1 disease on the target.

shaman.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
description: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 20 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Water Breathing
description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

shaman.name: Frost Resistance Totem
description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min. The totem increases party members' frost resistance by 60, if within 20 yards.

shaman.name: Far Sight
description: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

shaman.name: Magma Totem
description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 75 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

shaman.name: Mana Spring Totem
description: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 1 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 20 yards.

shaman.name: Fire Resistance Totem
description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that increases the fire resistance of party members within 20 yards by 60.

shaman.name: Flametongue Totem
description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enchants all party members' main-hand weapons with fire if they are within 20 yards. Each hit causes (1217 / 77 * 1) to (1217 / 25 * 1) additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Water Walking
description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

shaman.name: Astral Recall
description: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to Hearthstone Location. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

shaman.name: Grounding Totem
description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.

shaman.name: Nature Resistance Totem
description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that increases the nature resistance of party members within 20 yards by 60.

shaman.name: Reincarnation
description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

shaman.name: Windfury Weapon
description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. Lasts for 5 minutes.

shaman.name: Chain Lightning
description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 505 to 564 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

shaman.name: Windfury Totem
description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enchants all party members main-hand weapons with wind, if they are within 20 yards. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with (315 * 1) extra melee attack power. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Sentry Totem
description: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and shaman sight.

shaman.name: Windwall Totem
description: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 20 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
description: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 20 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Chain Heal
description: Heals the friendly target for 567 to 646, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.

shaman.name: Grace of Air Totem
description: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party members within 20 yards by 77. Lasts 2 min.

shaman.name: Tranquil Air Totem
description: Summons a Tranquil Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem reduces the threat caused by all party members within 20 yards by 20%. Lasts 2 min.

warlock.name: Shoot
description: Attack with an equipped wand.

warlock.name: Amplify Curse
description: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Curse of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

warlock.name: Conflagrate
description: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by Immolate, dealing 447 to 557 Fire damage and consuming the Immolate spell.

warlock.name: Curse of Exhaustion
description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 10% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

warlock.name: Dark Pact
description: Drains 250 of your pet's Mana, returning 100% to you.

warlock.name: Demonic Sacrifice
description: When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect that lasts 30 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.
Imp: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.
Voidwalker: Restores 3% of total Health every 4 sec.
Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.
Felhunter: Restores 2% of total Mana every 4 sec.

warlock.name: Fel Domination
description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

warlock.name: Shadowburn
description: Instantly blasts the target for 462 to 514 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

warlock.name: Siphon Life
description: Transfers 45 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

warlock.name: Soul Link
description: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter demon instead. In addition, both the demon and master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the demon is active.

warlock.name: Demon Skin
description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and restores 5 Health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

warlock.name: Immolate
description: Burns the enemy for 279 Fire damage and then an additional 510 Fire damage over 15 sec.

warlock.name: Shadow Bolt
description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 482 to 538 Shadow damage.

warlock.name: Summon Imp
description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

warlock.name: Corruption
description: Corrupts the target, causing 822 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

warlock.name: Curse of Weakness
description: Damage caused by the target is reduced by 31 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

warlock.name: Life Tap
description: Converts 424 health into 424 mana

warlock.name: Curse of Agony
description: Curses the target with agony, causing 1044 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

warlock.name: Fear
description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

warlock.name: Drain Soul

warlock.name: Summon Voidwalker
description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

warlock.name: Health Funnel
description: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

warlock.name: Curse of Recklessness
description: Curses the target with recklessness, increasing melee attack power by 90 but reducing armor by 640 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

warlock.name: Drain Life
description: Transfers 71 health every second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

warlock.name: Unending Breath
description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

warlock.name: Create Soulstone (Minor)
description: Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 400 health and 700 mana.

warlock.name: Searing Pain
description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 208 to 244 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

warlock.name: Demon Armor
description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and restores 15 health every 5 sec. for 30 min.

warlock.name: Rain of Fire
description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 904 Fire damage over 8 sec.

warlock.name: Ritual of Summoning
description: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

warlock.name: Summon Incubus
description: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

warlock.name: Summon Succubus
description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

warlock.name: Create Healthstone (Lesser)

warlock.name: Eye of Kilrogg
description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

warlock.name: Drain Mana
description: Transfers 140 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

warlock.name: Sense Demons
description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

warlock.name: Curse of Tongues
description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, slowing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

warlock.name: Detect Lesser Invisibility
description: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.

warlock.name: Banish
description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

warlock.name: Create Firestone (Lesser)
description: Creates a Lesser Firestone which can be equipped in the off hand. When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal 25 to 35 additional Fire damage. In addition, equipping the Lesser Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by 10.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

description: Creates a Lesser Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 750 health and 1200 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Hellfire
description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 213 Fire damage to himself and 213 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

warlock.name: Subjugate Demon
description: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 64, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

warlock.name: Summon Felhunter
description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

warlock.name: Curse of the Elements
description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Fire and Frost resistances by 75 and increasing Fire and Frost damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

warlock.name: Shadow Ward
description: Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

warlock.name: Create Healthstone
description: Creates a Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 500 health.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Create Firestone
description: Creates a Firestone which can be equipped in the off hand. When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal 40 to 60 additional Fire damage. In addition, equipping the Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by 14.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Create Spellstone

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Detect Invisibility
description: Allows the friendly target to detect invisibility for 10 min.

warlock.name: Create Soulstone
description: Creates a Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 1100 health and 1700 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Howl of Terror
description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

warlock.name: Summon Felsteed
description: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster. Speed is increased by 60%.

warlock.name: Death Coil
description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 476 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

warlock.name: Curse of Shadow
description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Shadow and Arcane resistances by 75 and increasing Shadow and Arcane damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

warlock.name: Create Firestone (Greater)
description: Creates a Greater Firestone which can be equipped in the off hand. When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal 60 to 90 additional Fire damage. In addition, equipping the Greater Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by 17.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Create Healthstone (Greater)

In addition, equipping the Greater Spellstone improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 1%.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Soul Fire
description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 715 to 894 Fire damage.

warlock.name: Create Soulstone (Greater)
description: Creates a Greater Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 1600 health and 2200 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Detect Greater Invisibility
description: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

warlock.name: Inferno
description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

warlock.name: Create Firestone (Major)
description: Creates a Major Firestone which can be equipped in the off hand. When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal 80 to 120 additional Fire damage. In addition, equipping the Major Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by 21.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Create Healthstone (Major)
description: Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1200 health.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Create Soulstone (Major)
description: Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2200 health and 2800 mana.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Create Spellstone (Major)
description: Creates a Major Spellstone for the caster. When equipped and used, the Major Spellstone removes all magic effects from the caster and will absorb 900 magic damage for 1 min. In addition, equipping the Major Spellstone improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 1%.
Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

warlock.name: Curse of Doom
description: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 3200 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players.

warlock.name: Ritual of Doom
description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

warlock.name: Summon Dreadsteed
description: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster. Speed is increased by 100%.

warrior.name: Throw
description: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

warrior.name: Bloodthirst
description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your attack power. In addition, the next 5 successful melee attacks will restore 20 health. This effect lasts 8 sec.

warrior.name: Concussion Blow
description: Stuns the opponent for 5 sec.

warrior.name: Death Wish
description: When activated, increases your physical damage by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but lowers your armor and all resistances by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

warrior.name: Last Stand
description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum hit points for 20 seconds. After the effect expires, the hit points are lost.

warrior.name: Mortal Strike
description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 160 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

warrior.name: Piercing Howl
description: Causes all enemies near the warrior to be dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

warrior.name: Shield Slam
description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 342 to 358 damage, modified by your shield block value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Also causes a high amount of threat.

warrior.name: Sweeping Strikes
description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

warrior.name: Battle Shout
description: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 20 yards by 232. Lasts 2 min.

warrior.name: Battle Stance
description: A balanced combat stance.

warrior.name: Heroic Strike
description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 157 and causes a high amount of threat.

warrior.name: Charge
description: Charge an enemy, generate 15 rage, and stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

warrior.name: Rend
description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

warrior.name: Thunder Clap
description: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 30 sec and doing 103 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

warrior.name: Hamstring
description: Maims the enemy, causing 45 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 50% for 15 sec.

warrior.name: Bloodrage
description: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec. The warrior is considered in combat for the duration.

warrior.name: Defensive Stance
description: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases threat generated.

warrior.name: Sunder Armor
description: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

warrior.name: Taunt
description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

warrior.name: Overpower
description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 35. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

warrior.name: Shield Bash
description: Bashes the target with your shield for 45 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

warrior.name: Demoralizing Shout
description: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 146 for 30 sec.

warrior.name: Revenge
description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 81 to 99 damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

warrior.name: Mocking Blow
description: A mocking attack that causes 93 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

warrior.name: Shield Block
description: Increases chance to block by 75% for 5 sec, but will only block 1 attack.

warrior.name: Disarm
description: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

warrior.name: Cleave
description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and his nearest ally.

warrior.name: Retaliation
description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

warrior.name: Intimidating Shout
description: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 total nearby enemies will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

warrior.name: Execute
description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 600 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 15 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

warrior.name: Challenging Shout
description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

warrior.name: Shield Wall
description: Reduces the damage taken from melee attacks, ranged attacks and spells by 75% for 10 sec.

warrior.name: Berserker Stance
description: An aggressive stance. Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

warrior.name: Intercept
description: Charge an enemy, causing 65 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

warrior.name: Slam
description: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

warrior.name: Berserker Rage
description: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

warrior.name: Whirlwind
description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage to each enemy.

warrior.name: Pummel
description: Pummel the target for 50 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

warrior.name: Recklessness
description: The warrior will cause critical hits with most attacks and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.
